goal: Emulate Cho et al. 2026 computational TLS definition to expand the number of USZ TLS foci, especially intratumoral ones.
paper_method: iStar super-resolution -> TLS signature score -> unsupervised clustering -> TLS segmentation. USZ has no H&E, so iStar is skipped; this uses expression only.

signature.score_v2: AUCell (rank-based, aucMaxRank = 5% of genes) over the signature; paper's convention
signature.score_v1_rejected: mean within-section z-scored log1p(counts); depth-confounded, Spearman with library size +0.73..+0.88 across sections, replaced before any gradient was computed

classification.IT: component touches a TUM spot within 130 um
classification.near: no touch but nearest TUM spot <= 400 um
classification.known_tls_frac: fraction of component spots labeled TLS by the pathologist

label_finding: LC4 and LC5 pathologist TLS spots are low-depth (median library 260/278 vs 655/6953 for NOR); expression-only detection cannot recover them. Report per section, do not pool over sections.

gradient_readout_circularity.note: Detection uses B+plasma+chemokines. Any readout sharing those genes is circular by construction and cannot count as a discovery.

not_a_result: This run only measures detection yield. No gradient is fit, no p-value is computed.
